**Description:**  
Fundamentalist criticism theory. This article deals with the study of the concept of fundamentalist criticism, its history, tools, paths, and its place in terms of criticism in the definition of the term fundamentalist. It explores the liberation of the subject of dispute in fundamentalist issues and determines the validity of fundamentalist statements, attributing them to their owners. The article distinguishes between verbal disagreement and real disagreement, and makes inferences on the fundamentalist issue. It also presents applied models of fundamentalist criticism of the scientific tender put forth by scientists in various investigations of jurisprudence.
